candidate_commit_resolution: the first commit carries the bundle and preflight integration, the second corrects pointer-only licence files; both are on dev and unpushed at measurement time

files: scripts/notice_bundle.py (new: graph walk, local text binding, canonical index, strict parser, manifest cross-check)

scripts/stage_portable.py (payload gains THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md; manifest cos-desktop-internal-portable-v2 with third_party_notices claim; verify recomputes digests/counts and fails closed; notices subcommand)
scripts/tests/test_stage_portable.py (v2 fixture and notice refusal cases)
binding_rules: every text is a verbatim local file or blob; nothing is fetched, generated, guessed or reworded
registry/git package roots come from cargo metadata manifest_path; workspace members bind the shared workspace LICENSE and NOTICE
a declared license-file is read only when it stays inside its package
a short single-line relative pointer is followed only for Git dependencies inside <CARGO_HOME>/git/checkouts; elsewhere it is POINTER_NOT_RESOLVED and the package stays unassessed
texts are deduplicated by SHA-256; the index is canonical JSON with a dependency-set digest; absolute paths, timestamps and machine names are never written
legal compliance is recorded as NOT_ASSESSED and the manifest keeps THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_CLOSURE_UNASSESSED

measurement.command: python -B scripts/stage_portable.py notices --output target/rel1-notices/run-a/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md (PYTHONHASHSEED 1, 2 and 3 for runs a, b and c; default --source-root)

assessment.note: TEXT_FOUND only records that a locally present licence text was bound verbatim and hashed. It is not a legal-compliance finding, and build-only dependencies are build inputs whose code need not ship.
